[[Spawning Power]] | damagetype = [[Lightning damage]] | unique = yes | icon = Platinum Staff }} [[Faith]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Xan Hei]] and [[Elite Ministry Cleric]]s, [[Elite Ministry Mage|Mages]], and [[Elite Ministry Illusionist|Illusionists]]. == Stats == :[[Energy]] +15 :[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%) :[[Lightning damage|Lightning Dmg]] 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]]) :Lightning Dmg 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Fast Casting]]) :Lightning Dmg 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Soul Reaping]]) :Lightning Dmg 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Energy Storage]]) :Lightning Dmg 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Spawning Power]]) :Energy +5 (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]]) :[[Health]] +45 (while Enchanted) ==Skin== This item uses the same skin as the [[Platinum Staff]] [[dye]]d white. ==Replica== Except for the visual appearance and [[damage type]], it is possible to create a replica of this staff with the same stats. Replicas will cause the damage type associated with the inherent [[attribute]]. Create a replica with the following: *Staff from crafter [[Ruricu]] *[[Perfect]] [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]] *Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Devotion]] OR *One of the following staves with the appropriate attribute: **[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]] **[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Weapon Master]] **[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]] **[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]] **[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]] **[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]] **[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]] **Staff from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Soros]], or [[Sende]] **[[Charr Staff]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]]) **[[Mursaat Staff]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack) **[[Tengu Staff]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack) **[[Undead Staff]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack) *Perfect Insightful Staff Head *Perfect Staff Wrapping of Devotion *Perfect [["Have Faith"]] inscription == Notes == * Many players believe this weapon will drop from any elite Ministry of Purity [[caster]]. * Other items with this appearance: **{{rt}} [[Fozzy's Staff]] ([[Unique item|unique]]) **{{n}} [[Kaolin Accursed Staff]] (unique) **{{me}} [[Kaolin Domination Staff]] (unique) **{{mo}} [[Kaolin Protection Staff]] (unique) **{{e}} [[Kaolin Water Staff]] (unique) **{{any}} [[Platinum Staff]] **{{any}} [[Staff of Purity]] **{{me}} [[Vision of Purity]] (unique) *Except for Spawning Power staves, [[Staff#Damage types of other staves|non-randomly generated]] Divine Favor, Fast Casting, Soul Reaping, and Energy Storage staves do not usually deal lightning damage. == Trivia == * Originally this item did not have a half skill recharge feature (which all max staves usually have). This was fixed in a later update, but existing staves were not changed.
